entity.name: SURA Insurance Plan in Colombia (Consumer-Facing)
criteria: Is it an insurance plan offered by SURA in Colombia?
Is it a consumer-facing plan (not business-to-business or wholesale)?
Does it belong to the 'Autos' or 'Salud' category?
Does it have at least 4 canonical benefits?
Does it have a price_min or clearly indicate 'quote' as the pricing_model?
Does it have an official source_primary_url from SURA?
entity.description: Consumer-facing insurance plans offered by SURA in Colombia, categorized as Autos or Salud, meeting strict quality rules.

attributes.name: provider_slug
attributes.description: Kebab case identifier for the insurance provider (e.g., 'sura')

attributes.name: provider_display
attributes.description: Official display name of the insurance provider (e.g., 'Seguros SURA')

attributes.name: category_slug
attributes.description: Kebab case identifier for the insurance category ('autos' or 'salud')

attributes.name: plan_slug
attributes.description: Unique kebab case identifier for the insurance plan (e.g., 'sura_autos_total')

attributes.name: plan_display
attributes.description: Official product name of the plan used in marketing

attributes.name: price_min
attributes.description: Base monthly or annual price, numeric

attributes.name: benefits
attributes.description: List of canonical benefit codes included in the plan

attributes.name: deductible
attributes.description: Text describing the deductible (required for Autos plans)

attributes.name: copay
attributes.description: Text describing the copay (required for Salud plans)

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of waiting period days (integer, Salud plans only; null if not applicable)

attributes.name: geo_scope
attributes.description: ISO list of countries where the plan is applicable; minimum ['CO']

attributes.name: last_verified_at
attributes.description: ISO datetime of when the plan data was last verified (scrape timestamp)

attributes.name: source_primary_url
attributes.description: Official web page or PDF link from SURA detailing the plan

attributes.name: external_purchase_url
attributes.description: Direct link for online purchase of the plan, if available

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Optional descriptive tags for the plan (e.g., 'mejor_precio', 'top_red')
